contract: Authored directed scene graphs with stable node/choice IDs, source revision snapshots, transactional player sessions and request-id replay.
acceptance_coverage: Actual console authoring creates a branching story with two endings through the real HTTP handler
Independent player sessions reach alternate endings and resume via URL
Store reopen and fresh Python process preserve exact session history
Edits and source deletion retain immutable revisions referenced by existing sessions
Graph validation refuses dangling, unreachable and trapped-cycle graphs
Optimistic writes and concurrent choices refuse stale revisions
Start and choice request retries replay exact receipts and conflicting reuse fails
Isolated homes and malformed payload rejection preserve scope
Console retains invalid and conflicted drafts with actual HTTP error messages

integration_hooks.agent_operations: stories GET/POST; stories/{id} GET/PUT/DELETE; sessions GET/POST; sessions/{id} GET; sessions/{id}/choices POST

remaining_limits: Root integrates handler, console navigation, native agent operations and durability inventory
Local console journey uses a DOM renderer and real local HTTP process; full browser and integrated hosted qualification are separate
No model generation, hosted voice or multiplayer is claimed

qualification.boundary: Local authored graph, durable player and actual console controls against real HTTP. Root integration remains separate.
